purpose: Verify creation of a basic Student user account
action_or_input: Provide valid user_id, institute_id, email, type STUDENT, program, batch
expected_result: User account created with ACTIVE status and baseline profile

purpose: Verify creation of a basic Faculty user account
action_or_input: Provide valid user_id, institute_id, email, type FACULTY, department
expected_result: Faculty account created with ACTIVE status

purpose: Verify creation of a basic Staff user account
action_or_input: Provide valid user_id, institute_id, email, type STAFF, department
expected_result: Staff account created with ACTIVE status

purpose: Refuse user creation with non-institutional email
action_or_input: Provide email with public domain (e.g. user@gmail.com)
expected_result: Action refused with 400 validation error

purpose: Refuse user creation with duplicate institute_id
action_or_input: Attempt to create another user with same institute_id
expected_result: Action refused with 400/409 duplicate identifier error

purpose: View user profile data by user_id
expected_result: 200 OK returning full profile metadata

purpose: Update editable profile fields for existing user
expected_result: 200 OK returning updated profile fields

purpose: Refuse update to immutable identity fields
action_or_input: Attempt to modify institute_id or user_id
expected_result: Immutable fields remain untouched and unchanged

purpose: Deactivate an active user account
action_or_input: POST /users/{user_id}/deactivate/ with reason and step-up auth
expected_result: Status changes to DEACTIVATED with timestamp and audit entry

purpose: Reactivate a deactivated user account
expected_result: Status changes back to ACTIVE with audit entry

purpose: Refuse deactivation without step-up authentication
preconditions: User is ACTIVE; no step-up auth
expected_result: Action refused with 403 step_up_auth_required

purpose: Bulk create users from CSV batch
expected_result: All 5 accounts created; summary reports 5 successes, 0 errors

purpose: Bulk status update for user accounts
action_or_input: POST /users/bulk-status/ with list of user_ids to DEACTIVATED
expected_result: Target accounts transitioned to DEACTIVATED; batch logged

purpose: Refuse bulk batch exceeding maximum limit
expected_result: Action refused with 400 validation error

purpose: Inspect role definitions and assignment metadata
expected_result: 200 OK returning role assignments and metadata

purpose: Assign additional role with validity dates
expected_result: Role assignment created in ACTIVE/SCHEDULED status

purpose: Refuse singular role assignment when already occupied
preconditions: Singular role Dean actively held by User A
action_or_input: Attempt to assign Dean to User B
expected_result: Refused with 409 singular role conflict

purpose: Reassign existing role with handover transfer
preconditions: Active role assignment held by User A
action_or_input: POST /roles/{id}/reassign/ with successor User B and summary
expected_result: Old role revoked, new role assigned, handover logged

purpose: Revoke held additional role
expected_result: Role status changed to REVOKED

purpose: Extend validity of active role assignment
action_or_input: POST /roles/{id}/extend/ with new valid_to and justification
expected_result: Role validity extended with updated valid_to timestamp

purpose: Enforce access boundary by active role permissions
action_or_input: Switch active role and query endpoints
expected_result: Access granted only to endpoints authorized for active role

purpose: Archive eligible deactivated user
expected_result: Status transitions to ARCHIVED_REVERSIBLE; reversibility_expires_at set

purpose: Refuse archival of active user account
expected_result: Refused with 409 invalid state transition

purpose: Restore archived user within reversibility window
expected_result: User status restored to ACTIVE; restoration audit logged

purpose: Refuse restoration of expired reversible user (BW-SA-08)
preconditions: User is ARCHIVED_REVERSIBLE with past reversibility_expires_at
expected_result: Refused with 409 conflict and user committed to ARCHIVED_PERMANENT

purpose: Archive historical inactive dataset
preconditions: Historical dataset with retention threshold met
expected_result: Historical archive record created with retention schedule

purpose: Search and export archived records
expected_result: 200 OK returning read-only archive dataset

purpose: Restore archived historical dataset
expected_result: Historical dataset restored to active state

purpose: Request permanent data purge
expected_result: Purge request created with REQUESTED status

purpose: Dual-authorize permanent data purge by IT Head
expected_result: Purge authorized; archive record permanently purged

purpose: Maintain append-only immutable audit log evidence
expected_result: Audit entries immutable; deletion or update raises error

purpose: Configure versioned permitted system parameters
action_or_input: POST /config/ with parameter_key and JSON value
expected_result: New versioned policy parameter record created; previous closed
